note_en: Chinese passives with 被 often leave out who does the action: 一些还能使用的零件，会被小心地拆下来重新利用 "some parts that still work are carefully removed to be reused." English "are removed" works the same way, but Chinese uses 被 far less often than English uses the passive: in 其他无法再利用的部分，则要经过专门的工序安全地处理掉 "the other parts have to be disposed of safely," the parts are clearly on the receiving end, yet there is no passive marker at all.
